## Trial `boot-kernel-parameter-ubuntu24__t7mJqu8`

### Operational hygiene

The verifier assigned hygiene **1.000**. All executor commands are either read-only discovery/verification, a single targeted sed edit to /etc/default/grub (necessary and scoped), an update-grub regeneration (necessary), or the mandated single reboot used both to satisfy the 'across reboots' requirement and the restart-evidence protocol. No unnecessary, unrelated, or unreverted mutations were found. The two non-zero return codes (a connection-reset during reboot, and a chained diagnostic command whose final sub-command against a nonexistent /proc/sys/kernel/audit path failed) are expected artifacts of the reboot and read-only diagnostics, not state-changing failures.
